title: Wall St Week Ahead: Investors brace for possible rate hike at uncertain Fed meeting
text: Wall St Week Ahead: Investors brace for possible rate hike at uncertain Fed meeting. As the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision looms next week, investors are on edge, aware that this could disrupt the ongoing stock market rally alongside rising bond yields. The latest consumer inflation data from August has sparked expectations of a rate hike, with the likelihood of a quarter-percentage point increase gaining traction. The Fed's forthcoming choice will play a crucial role in shaping the monetary policy landscape ahead.
